text:
marta: Hey team, quick heads up — ran into a 404 on an anchor inside the runtime guide while following the batching examples. The link from /runtime/batching.md#kv-cache -> #kv-cache-eviction goes to a 404. Anyone own that page? :thinking:
henry: @marta can you paste the exact link? I can take a quick look now.
marta: Sure — https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/batching.md#kv-cache-eviction (clicking it jumps to top and then 404 in staging). Also saw a console error: 
```
GET /runtime/batching.md#kv-cache-eviction 404
```
samir: Ugh, probably an anchor id rename during the runbook merge last week. We changed `kv-cache-eviction` to `kv-cache-lifecycle` but left some internal refs.
lisa: If that's true a mass sed replace might fix other spots. I can do a tiny PR if you want.
marta: That would be awesome. Thinking of a two-line sed we can run across the repo: 
```bash
rg "kv-cache-eviction" -n --hidden | cut -d: -f1 | uniq | xargs -I{} sed -i "s/kv-cache-eviction/kv-cache-lifecycle/g" {}
git add -A && git commit -m "docs: fix kv-cache anchor refs" && git push
```
henry: Nice. Can you scope it to docs/ and staging branch? Maybe run a dry-run first: 
```bash
rg "kv-cache-eviction" docs/ -n --hidden
```
marta: Yep did a dry run locally — found 5 files. I'll open a PR to staging. Putting draft now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8472 (draft).
henry: ETA to convert to ready for review? I can do a quick pass for formatting and frontmatter if you want.
marta: Give me 10m to tidy commit message and add changelog entry.
lisa: If it's small I'll review and merge once CI passes. Please include a changelog line under "docs:"
samir: Also ping localization for ja backport — anchors can break translated TOCs. I can open the backport once main is merged.
docs-bot: CI update for PR #8472: checks/markdown-lint passed, checks/linkcheck found 1 new broken internal link in /i18n/ja/runtime/batching.md: pointing to #kv-cache-eviction (status: failing).
lisa: docs-bot noted linkcheck failure — I'll hold merge until samir and I coordinate the ja backport.
marta: Pushed an extra commit to update the ja pointer to the new anchor (temporary fix) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8472/commits/3a2f.
henry: Looks good. :thumbsup: I'll eyeball frontmatter and then approve. If anyone else hits similar anchor rot, drop the file path in this thread and we'll triage as a batch.
marta: Thanks all — appreciated. :wave:
samir: I'll handle the ja backport after merge and ping @lisa once it's staged.
lisa: sounds good. merging after samir confirms backport plan.
docs-bot: PR #8472 merged into staging by lisa (checks: green).
marta: Great, reopening the original flow and testing — anchor now resolves in staging. Confirmed.
henry: nice quick win.
lisa: leaving a short note in the sprint board under docs-fixes.
marta: closing the thread, will follow up if anything weird crops up. Thanks again!
